name: intersign-agent-skills
description: Create, inspect, validate, and assess furniture layouts with bounded next actions in Intersign through MCP.

interface.longDescription: Use Intersign's MCP tools to work with editable building scenes, validate and save results, and produce bounded furniture footprint reports with explicit evidence, limitations, and blocker-aware next actions.
defaultPrompt: Use Intersign to inspect this project, make the requested bounded edit, validate it, save it, and return the editor URL.
Check whether this furniture footprint fits in a measured Intersign room, including rotations, collisions, and door access.
